def test_auth_signup_and_login():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    password = "password123"

    signup_url = get_url("gateway", "/auth/signup")
    resp = requests.post(signup_url, json={"user": username, "password": password}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    token = resp.json().get("token")
    assert token is not None

    # Verify user creation via GET /user/me
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
    me_resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/user/me"), headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert me_resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {me_resp.status_code}: {me_resp.text}"
    assert me_resp.json()["user"] == username

    # Negative: Signup with existing username
    resp = requests.post(signup_url, json={"user": username, "password": password}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Login success
    login_url = get_url("gateway", "/auth/login")
    resp = requests.post(login_url, json={"user": username, "password": password}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert "token" in resp.json()

    # Negative: Login with invalid password
    resp = requests.post(login_url, json={"user": username, "password": "wrongpassword"}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_wallet_balance_and_topup():
    _, _, token = create_user_and_login()
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}

    # Initial balance should be 0
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    data = resp.json()
    assert data["balance"] == 0
    address = data["address"]
    assert address is not None

    # Topup
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup"), headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    topup_data = resp.json()
    assert topup_data["address"] == address
    assert topup_data["balance"] > 0
    new_balance = topup_data["balance"]

    # Verify balance updated
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["balance"] == new_balance

    # Negative: Topup again should fail
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup"), headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_wallet_transfer_success():
    _, _, token_a = create_user_and_login()
    _, _, token_b = create_user_and_login()

    headers_a = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_a}"}
    headers_b = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_b}"}

    # Topup User A
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup"), headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    balance_a = resp.json()["balance"]
    address_a = resp.json()["address"]

    # Get User B address
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_b, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    balance_b = resp.json()["balance"]
    address_b = resp.json()["address"]

    transfer_amount = balance_a / 2.0 if balance_a > 0 else 0

    # Transfer A -> B
    payload = {"to": address_b, "amount": transfer_amount}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), headers=headers_a, json=payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["balance"] == balance_a - transfer_amount

    # Verify A balance
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["balance"] == balance_a - transfer_amount

    # Verify B balance
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_b, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["balance"] == balance_b + transfer_amount

    # Transfer 0 (no-op)
    payload = {"to": address_b, "amount": 0}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), headers=headers_a, json=payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["balance"] == balance_a - transfer_amount

    # Transfer to self (no-op)
    payload = {"to": address_a, "amount": transfer_amount}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), headers=headers_a, json=payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["balance"] == balance_a - transfer_amount

def test_wallet_transfer_failures():
    _, _, token_a = create_user_and_login()
    headers_a = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_a}"}

    # Topup User A
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup"), headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    balance_a = resp.json()["balance"]

    # Missing 'to'
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), headers=headers_a, json={"amount": 10}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Missing 'amount'
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), headers=headers_a, json={"to": "some_address"}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Negative amount
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), headers=headers_a, json={"to": "some_address", "amount": -10}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Insufficient funds
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), headers=headers_a, json={"to": "some_address", "amount": balance_a + 100}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Recipient not found
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), headers=headers_a, json={"to": "non_existent_address_123", "amount": 1}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
